;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen]]
**At least 30 people are reported to have been killed in Saudi-led coalition air strikes on a rebel military police camp in [[Yemen]]'s capital, [[Sanaa]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-42338359 (BBC)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**Militant [[State of Palestine|Palestinians]] fire rockets towards [[Israel]] from the [[Gaza Strip]]. The [[Israel Defense Forces]] say that the [[Iron Dome]] system intercepted two missiles, while one rocket fell in a flat open area and nobody was hurt. [https://www.hln.be/nieuws/buitenland/israel-palestina/militante-palestijnen-vuren-opnieuw-raketten-op-israel-af~a473f9e9/ (''Het Laatste Nieuws'')]
**The leader of [[Hamas]], [[Ismail Haniyeh]], calls for a new revolt or [[intifada]]. [https://www.hln.be/nieuws/buitenland/israel-palestina/militante-palestijnen-vuren-opnieuw-raketten-op-israel-af~a473f9e9/ (''Het Laatste Nieuws'')]

;Arts and culture
*[[2017 Rohingya persecution in Myanmar|Rohingya persecution in Myanmar]]
**[[Dublin City Council]]lors vote 59–2 to revoke the [[Freedom of the City of Dublin]] given to [[Myanmar]]'s [[Aung San Suu Kyi]] for her apparent failure to protect the [[Rohingya people|Rohingya]] minority from violence. Singer [[Bob Geldof]] returned his Freedom one month ago, protesting that Suu Kyi also held the honour. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/dec/14/aung-san-suu-kyi-has-freedom-of-dublin-award-revoked (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/nov/13/bob-geldof-renounces-honour-also-held-by-aung-san-suu-kyi (''The Guardian'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Marine Corps Air Station Futenma]]
**A 17-pound (8 kg) [[Sikorsky CH-53E Super Stallion#H-53E|CH-53E]] [[transport helicopter]] window lands on school grounds in [[Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa]], [[Japan]], marking the second time in less than a week that an American aircraft part has fallen on a school there. Today, a child sustains "minor injuries". The [[United States Marine Corps]] apologizes. [http://abcnews.go.com/International/International/marine-corps-apologizes-aircraft-part-falls-2nd-japanese/story?id=51760688 (ABC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Proclamation No. 216]]
**The [[Congress of the Philippines]] votes to approve [[President of the Philippines|President]] [[Rodrigo Duterte]]'s request to extend the declaration of [[Martial law in the Philippines|martial law]] in [[Mindanao]] until December 31, 2018. [https://www.afp.com/en/news/23/philippines-duterte-wins-extra-year-martial-law-powers-doc-v43kn3 (AFP)]
*[[Operation Car Wash]]
**[[Ecuador]]ian [[Vice President of Ecuador|Vice President]] [[Jorge Glas]] is sentenced to six years imprisonment for [[Corruption in Ecuador|financial corruption]] involving the [[Brazil]]ian construction company [[Odebrecht]]. The decision will not be enforced until the court confirms the ruling. The court's decision can be appealed. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-42346881 (BBC News)] [https://www.eluniverso.com/noticias/2017/12/13/nota/6525058/jorge-glas-sentenciado-como-culpable-6-anos-prision-caso-odebrecht (''El Universo'')] {{in lang|es}}
*[[Rohingya insurgency in Western Myanmar]]
**Two [[Reuters]] journalists are arrested in [[Myanmar]] for trying to illegally obtain official documents. They were reporting about the [[Rohingya people|Rohingya Muslim]] community in [[Rakhine State]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2017/12/13/world/asia/myanmar-rakhine-reporters.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of the United States]]
**[[Minnesota]] Governor [[Mark Dayton]] announces the appointment of Lt. Gov. [[Tina Smith]] to replace resigning Sen. [[Al Franken]] in the [[United States Senate]]. [http://www.twincities.com/2017/12/13/full-text-of-minn-gov-mark-dayton-naming-tina-smith-to-replace-al-franken/ (''St. Paul Pioneer Press'')]
*[[Politics of the United Kingdom]]
**[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Theresa May]] suffers a 309–305 defeat, her first, in [[House of Commons of the United Kingdom|the House of Commons]] when MPs from both major parties approve an amendment to the [[Brexit]] bill subjecting a Brexit agreement to a preliminary vote by Parliament. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2017/dec/13/tory-brexit-rebels-inflict-major-defeat-on-theresa-may (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-42346192 (BBC)]
*[[2017 United States political sexual scandals]]
**[[Kentucky House of Representatives|Kentucky state legislator]] [[Dan Johnson (Kentucky politician)|Dan Johnson]], who had been accused of sexual assault of a teenager, dies of a gunshot wound, an apparent suicide. [https://apnews.com/6e4609918fea4cef81b1052540e346d7/Ky.-lawmaker-accused-of-assault-dies-in-apparent-suicide (AP)]
